service_scope: Treat international flights and Colombia ground services as outside MBW pricing unless the owner explicitly adds them.
Ecuador guiding, Ecuador ground transportation, reserve entrance fees, lodging and specifically requested activities may be sent for pricing.
A guest's sample itinerary is source material, not an approved MBW route or a statement of availability.
Wildlife sightings, lodging and holiday services are never guaranteed.
Guide responses and supplier prices belong only to the linked custom-tour record; they are not reusable public prices or confirmed guest prices.
Reference itineraries, brochures and flight documents for other travelers must remain separate from the current guest facts.
supplier_quote_rules: Preserve the original guide response alongside any structured extraction.
Match quoted services to the guest itinerary by exact date before using day order.
Store included, excluded, optional and pending items separately.
Treat food and lodging as excluded unless the guide explicitly includes them for a specific day.
Require owner review and markup before any supplier cost becomes a guest-facing price.
required_quote_facts: exact travel window and known arrival/departure details

recommendations: Keep the bear-search days flexible and verify current sightings and access before fixing the exact valleys or viewpoints.
Consider Quito as the operational base for the northern bear-search segment so the guide can adjust sites using current local reports.
Consider a full-day Antisana outing for Andean Condor and high-Andean wildlife before the bear-search segment.
Use Mindo as the birding base and combine Bellavista with a contrasting lower-elevation reserve rather than spending a complete day at only one site.
For additional Chocó birding, consider Mashpi Amagusa or another complementary reserve before transferring toward Cotopaxi.
Treat Cotopaxi, horse riding and Quito-area sightseeing as a separate closing segment whose routing must be confirmed.
